campaign_name: PR-BR Continuation 25 — Contract-First Semantic Ownership Reconciliation
purpose: Reconcile ordinary natural-language gameplay around one Resolution Contract, then validate with at most six live turns. PR-BR stays open.
executive_summary: Ordinary chat now builds one Resolution Contract before specialized resolvers run. Historical C12-C24 suites held, and the Y1-Y20 matrix passed. The six-turn live session kept a contract on every turn and did not mismatch accepted and emitted text, but manual review was 4/6. Turn 4 showed the adjudication family selector still treating tavern/shelter tokens as a place question inside a contemplated plan. Turn 1 sealed a JSON blob after labeling speech as an act. Decision: C25 revealed a deeper semantic-architecture dependency. No 4x10 gate. No human playtest. No commit.

production: game/ordinary_semantic_ownership.py establishes one contract and selects the resolver.
game/api.py runs that boundary before social, exploration, travel, world-action, generic intent, and attack execution.
game/resolution_contract.py treats passive wait, direct attack, committed go/head/walk, and local-presence questions as contract operations.
game/perception_grounding.py realizes local-presence answers from the current scene before the response is sealed.
validation: tests/test_pr_br_continuation25_semantic_ownership.py covers Y1-Y20, multi-clause ownership, the single-owner source order, and stubbed chat.
tooling: artifacts/pr_br_continuation25/run_live.py runs at most six live turns in one isolated session.

testing.focused: C25 ownership tests passed, including Y1-Y20.
testing.broader: C12-C24 modules passed. Local-presence and nearby HTTP tests passed. One pre-existing question-rule unit test stayed red.
testing.runtime_validation: 6 completed live turns. 3 interpretation invocations. 5 gameplay generations. 1 retry. No smoke. No 4x10. No repair rerun.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: 3 interpretation invocations. 5 initial gameplay generations. 1 retry. 0 evaluator calls. 6 player-model calls.
testing.new_regressions: Live turn 4 place-token takeover and live turn 1 JSON emission. Not patched after the session.

decisions_requiring_human_review: Whether another implementation cycle should replace lexical adjudication-family selection with contract fields, before any 4x10 gate.

campaign_specific: Ask plus the words tavern or shelter can still select place_location.
A validated interpretation can label a spoken approach as an act.
A sealed retry can include raw JSON in the player-visible text.

missing_concepts: Family selection that uses contract operation and commitment without re-reading raw tokens as a second owner.
does_not_prove: It does not prove the second 4x10 gate would pass.
It does not prove every ask is free of lexical family takeover.
It does not authorize human playtest or PR-BS.
recommended_next_step: External review. Do not open C26, do not run the 4x10 gate, and do not patch the tavern/shelter trigger from this live session.

supporting_files.why: Unified contract boundary and resolver selection.
